K3/K6 (native-host signing of the extens.reason: One extension transport, services/LaravelTransport.ts laravelFetch, used by BaseApiClient (Worker/TaskCenter/StudyGen/Assist), QueueCenterWakeService, duoreader-importer-core and ai-web-common. It sends only {method, path+rawQuery as sent, contentType, contentSha256} over native messaging. The digest is the WebCrypto sha256 of the exact body; FormData signs the contract UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD with multipart. The host (client-key-signer.ts) validates the payload shape and calls ncore signRequest with client 'mcp_chrome' and the precomputed digest, which ncore validates, and returns only headers or a contract error code. The key and the canonical string never leave the host, and nothing reaches extension storage. Without a signature the call goes out unsigned and Laravel fails client.key routes closed; an unresponsive host pauses signing for 30 s; warnings are throttled and do not log the key.

cross_end: ncore signRequest reproduces test_vectors.json (verified independently in ncore-1). The owner ran the full signRequest path with the test key injected in memory and a pinned clock: headers and signatures match and ncore verifyRequestHeaders accepts all three. The fields sent (method, path+search as fetch transmits it, digest of the exact bytes) match what Laravel ClientKeyAuthService verifies (getPathInfo, QUERY_STRING, getContent, Content-Type media type).
